body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Proves chip timing closes across all corners without exhaustive simulation. A static timing analysis tool propagates arrival times through a netlist with liberty (.lib) timing models, checking setup, hold, recovery, and removal across PVT corners. Real implementations include OpenSTA (open), PrimeTime, and Tempus. It reports worst violators, supports AOCV/POCV variation, and signs off tape-out timing.

title: Static Timing Analysis Tool — Teaching-ladder exercise
t: Static Timing Analysis Tool — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Proves chip timing closes across all corners without exhaustive simulation.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Static Timing Analysis Tool, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Graph-based arrival/required time propagation). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Graph-based arrival/required time propagation and Multi-corner, multi-mode (MCMM) analysis. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Integrated circuit layout editor) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
